Bumps [spmd-types](https://github.com/meta-pytorch/spmd_types) from 0.2.3 to 0.3.0.
Release notes

Sourced from spmd-types's releases.

v0.3.0

Full Changelog: https://github.com/meta-pytorch/spmd_types/compare/v0.2.5...v0.3.0

v0.2.5

Full Changelog: https://github.com/meta-pytorch/spmd_types/compare/v0.2.4...v0.2.5

v0.2.4

Full Changelog: https://github.com/meta-pytorch/spmd_types/compare/v0.2.3...v0.2.4

Commits
  • f733a4e Keep rulecheck compatible with Python 3.10
  • bfa07e3 Respect local mesh axes in rules.einsum
  • 9e8526a Decay unrepresentable local shards across meshes
  • b9242ea Honor defaults in shared typing hooks
  • 13aaffe Support callable no_typecheck
  • 25086d5 Support shard refinement and in-place rule outputs
  • 6041487 Add reinterpret_no_grad for replicated tensors
  • 2841775 Automated cleanup/update of MSL/TBD BUCK Files
  • c8c11c6 Simplify rulecheck reference handling and reports
  • 2457b2b rules: composable spmd_typecheck hooks and rulecheck
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view
